data.narrative:
Intramotev is a Series A stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $14.4M to date. The broader peer universe comprises eight private companies in this space, including notably Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro, though no direct public comparables exist for this subsector. 

Given the limited availability of same-stage or valuation-tier peers within Drones & Autonomous—the analysis identified zero same-stage peers, one adjacent-stage peer, and zero similar-tier peers—the Peer-Median method was not applicable. Accordingly, the valuation relies on Stage-Progression analysis, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $14.4M total raised as a value proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $28.8M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $24.5M to $33.1M, with a median point of $28.8M. This range incorporates downside and upside sensitivities around the stage-progression multiple but reflects constraint from a single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.0x multiplier for this particular subsector and the absence of granular comparable transaction data. A more robust conclusion would require either narrower peer identification within Drones & Autonomous or additional methodology (revenue multiples, DCF calibration) if such data becomes available.
